_about: Extracted from each Codex session log (~/.codex/sessions/2026/11/<day>/rollout-*.jsonl): every image_gen call Codex made for one render of IMG_05_001 to IMG_05_008, in order, with the prompt Codex itself wrote for the tool (Codex rewrites the prompt it is given, so these are NOT the registry text). picked = the call whose output sha256 equals the file Codex saved to the requested path, which is the file copied byte-identical to images/. references_at_image_tool = what that call passed as referenced_image_paths: the style anchor images/IMG_02_003.png, the previous call's output, or none. Renders that were discarded and re-rendered (IMG_05_004, IMG_05_007 twice, IMG_05_008) are not listed here; the registry notes name why. This file lives under images/ because the gh303-art evidence directory is outside the brief for the 2026-11-16 render; the extractor is the gh303-art one with the session glob widened and references_at_image_tool added, and it lives in the session scratch directory, not in the repo. Local paths are replaced by placeholders.
